summary: W2 Alembic main rework for §4b(C1) PD-5 hard gate: controller raw review found runBootstrapPlanGate requests generationStage coldStart but does not verify the returned PlanSelection.generationStage matches coldStart before applyPlanSelection/coldStart. This leaves a wrong-stage but shape-valid PlanSelection able to drive coldStart, which violates the coldStart plan hard precondition and AI failure surfacing. Implement only this guard in Alembic main: after runPlanAgent and before applyPlanSelection, reject any selection whose generationStage is not coldStart, record the same plan-gate error/job failure path, runColdStartWorkflow 0 times, and keep no fallback-to-full wording or behavior. Add a focused unit test with generationStage deepMining + non-empty dimensions proving the job fails before coldStart. Re-run Node>=22 focused DaemonJobRunnerPlanGate/ColdStartPlanSelection tests plus build:check/typecheck/lint/import-boundary/diff-check as appropriate. Commit on Alembic main and return commit hash, changed files, validations, raw evidence, and residual risks. Do not edit AlembicCore, AlembicAgent, AlembicPlugin, vendor, schema, or public contracts.
